package.name: robot_pvt_control
package.description:
Whole-body PVT (CiA 402 mode 5) controller for the 25-joint humanoid. Streams position / velocity / torque-FF / Kp / Kd setpoints to every MyActuator drive at 1 kHz; drives run τ = Kp·Δp + Kd·Δv + τ_ff in firmware. Exposes both a streaming setpoint topic and a FollowJointTrajectory action with cubic/quintic-Hermite interpolation, plus hold / free services, a whole-body lag governor, and centralised safety (clamps + thermal Kp derating + e-stop FREE/HOLD via librobot_safety).
Ported from pendulum_pvt_control — generalised N=1 → N=25.
